conventions.name: project-root-uses-src-layout
conventions.description: The project root places importable code under src/ and keeps pyproject.toml at the top level.
conventions.hint: Move importable code into a src/ directory and keep pyproject.toml at the project root.

conventions.name: top-level-src-packages-have-init
conventions.description: Each top-level package under src/ is a real package with an __init__.py.
conventions.hint: Add an __init__.py to this directory so it's importable as a package.

conventions.name: init-files-are-barrels
conventions.description: Package __init__.py files never contain business logic; only docstrings, imports, __all__, and re-export aliases.
conventions.hint: Move non-barrel logic (functions, classes, business logic) out of this __init__.py into a dedicated module and re-export it here instead.

conventions.name: package-inits-have-docstrings
conventions.description: Package __init__.py files document the package with a module docstring.
conventions.hint: Add a module docstring to this __init__.py summarizing what the package exposes and why.

conventions.name: max-module-length
conventions.description: Modules longer than 300 lines should be split.
conventions.hint: Split this module into smaller single-purpose modules behind the same import surface.

conventions.name: absolute-imports-only
conventions.description: Non-barrel modules use absolute imports instead of relative imports.
conventions.hint: Rewrite relative imports (from . import x, from .. import y) as absolute imports rooted at the top-level package.

conventions.name: no-typing-any
conventions.description: typing.Any defeats the type checker; annotate precisely.
conventions.hint: Replace Any with a precise type, a TypeVar, or object if the value is genuinely opaque.

conventions.name: annotated-public-functions
conventions.description: Public functions and methods annotate parameters and return values.
conventions.hint: Add type annotations to this public function's parameters and return value.

conventions.name: no-anonymous-record-annotations
conventions.description: Annotations use named record types instead of identity-less string-keyed mappings with broad or union value types.
conventions.hint: Define a named type for the record shape, such as a pydantic model, TypedDict, or dataclass, and use that name in the annotation.

conventions.name: docstrings-on-public-api
conventions.description: Public classes and functions have docstrings.
conventions.hint: Add a docstring explaining what this public class or function does, its parameters, and what it returns.

conventions.name: public-api-modules-declare-all
conventions.description: Public (non-underscore) modules declare their export surface with an explicit __all__.
conventions.hint: Add an explicit __all__ list naming the names this module intends to expose publicly.

conventions.name: no-underscore-exports
conventions.description: Modules never list underscore-prefixed names in __all__.
conventions.hint: Drop the underscore-prefixed name from __all__, or rename it without the leading underscore if it's meant to be public.

conventions.name: tests-mirror-top-level-modules
conventions.description: Every top-level src/ module has a matching tests/test_<module>.py file.
conventions.hint: Add a tests/test_<module>.py covering this module's public behavior.

conventions.name: tests-mirror-package-modules
conventions.description: Every public module inside a src/ package has a matching tests/<package>/test_<module>.py file.
conventions.hint: Add a tests/<package>/test_<module>.py mirroring this module's location under src/; underscore-private modules are tested through their public facade.

conventions.name: no-print-statements
conventions.description: Library code never uses bare print(); reserve stdout for CLI entry points.
conventions.hint: Use logging (or the CLI layer) instead of print() in library code.

conventions.name: no-todo-comments
conventions.description: Source modules do not accumulate TODO/FIXME/XXX markers; work lives in the issue tracker.
conventions.hint: Remove the marker and file a tracked issue for the remaining work instead of leaving it in a comment.

conventions.name: no-repeated-string-literals
conventions.description: Source does not repeat the same non-trivial string literal across the codebase.
conventions.hint: Extract repeated string values into a named constant and reference that name instead.

conventions.name: no-duplicate-functions
conventions.description: Functions and methods do not duplicate another normalized implementation.
conventions.hint: Extract shared implementation into one helper, or make the duplicate implementations meaningfully different.
